candidates.name: CityGML
verified_facts: CityGML defines a conceptual model and exchange format for virtual 3D city models.
CityGML supports semantic representation of urban objects, geometry, relationships and levels of detail for multiple application domains.
semantic_limits: A 3D city-model geometry or level of detail is not automatically a surveyed bare-earth terrain observation and does not certify parcel-height accuracy.

candidates.name: CityJSON
verified_facts: CityJSON is a JSON-based exchange format for digital 3D models of cities and landscapes.
It implements a subset of the CityGML data model and is designed to simplify structure and reduce file size.
semantic_limits: Encoding a 3D model in CityJSON does not establish survey origin, terrain classification, vertical datum or numeric elevation accuracy.
